newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The forthcoming SAARC summit, due on March 12 in the Maldives, is expected to work out a strategy for establishing broad-based links with other regional bodies like ASEAN, EU and APEC.
Government has formed an expert committee with noted personalities to suggest measures to improve the standard of programmes of the state-run Bangladesh Television.
Leaders of the Shantibahini tribal insurgents will sit for next round of peace talks with the government in Dhaka on May 11.
Central bank governor Lutfor Rahman Sarker on Tuesday said the country's banking system was on the verge of collapse because of huge amount of default loans.
Bangladesh and Iran have agreed to intensify institutional cooperation in horticulture and other agricultural fields.
The Indo-Chinese and ASEAN countries, including Thailand, are now looking towards the South Asia for their overseas investment, said a senior official of the Thai board of investment.
The visiting Thai Deputy Foreign Minister Pitak Intrawityanunt said on Tuesday Bangladesh was on the priority list of potential partner countries regarding trade and investment.
Country's tanning industry is facing acute shortage of raw hides and skin due to large-scale smuggling to neighbouring India. REUTER
